title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: 别睡，保持警戒：面向计算机使用智能体的主动感知
abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than $30\times$ its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.
abstract_zh: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的计算机使用智能体（CUA）越来越多地承担桌面、网页和移动端的长程任务，但它们通常只能通过离散截图感知不断变化的界面。VLM 的推理延迟进一步拉大了感知与行动之间的时间差，导致动作执行时，决策所依据的界面状态往往已经过时。为此，本文提出即插即用框架 NightWatch，无需修改智能体的模型、提示词或动作空间，即可为其提供持续、与当前界面状态同步的感知。NightWatch 通过轻量级 System-1 模型 NightWatch-0.8B 实时监测界面变化，以较低的计算开销和延迟减少基于过时状态的操作与空等。在 OSWorld-Verified 上，NightWatch 将非推理耗时缩短 33%、无效耗时减少 53%，同时保持任务成功率基本不变；在 DynaCU-Bench 上，搭配大型 VLM 智能体时，任务成功率由 39.5% 提升至 44.2%。在同样仅使用截图作为输入的条件下，NightWatch 比 AOI、PUSV 等被动监测基线以及参数量超过其 30 倍的 System-1 决策模型更高效。结果表明，对动态界面中的智能体而言，何时感知与感知什么同样重要。
key_points_zh: 离散截图与 VLM 推理延迟叠加，使智能体执行动作时，原先看到的界面状态可能已经过时。
NightWatch 用仅 8 亿参数的 NightWatch-0.8B 持续监测界面，无需修改现有智能体的模型、提示词或动作空间。
在 OSWorld-Verified 上，非推理耗时减少 33%，无效耗时减少 53%，任务成功率基本不变。
在 DynaCU-Bench 上，搭配大型 VLM 智能体时，成功率从 39.5% 升至 44.2%，提高 4.7 个百分点。
在仅使用截图的条件下，NightWatch 比 AOI、PUSV 等被动监测基线及参数量超过其 30 倍的 System-1 决策模型更高效。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是为视觉语言计算机操作智能体加入流式屏幕监测，使其在不改动模型、提示或动作空间的情况下跟上界面变化。两项基准量化了耗时和成功率收益，但摘要不足以复现该机制或确定其适用边界。
